test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

There was never much ________ between the two sisters. They didn't see eye to eye.
solution:
The correct answer is **rapport.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **See eye to eye****:**** **to be in full agreement.
 
• Here, the sentence expresses the meaning that the two sisters were not in full agreement because there was never much friendly relationship between them. 
 
• **Rapport**: a friendly, harmonious relationship
 
• Hence the most suitable word to fill in the blank is** rapport. **

**​**The correct option is **Option 4.**

8d
